text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to limit sugar and junk food. Second, exercise regularly. Even a short walk every day can help you stay fit and feel better. Third, get enough sleep, about seven to eight hours each night. Good sleep gives you energy for the next day. Don't forget your mental health, too. Talk to friends or family when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. Make time for rest and hobbies, not just work. These simple habits can make you healthier and happier.
